lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The high-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately six to eight horizontal rows along the visible mid-section. The spatial density is highest in the anterior region, with inter-blob distance increasing toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of spots to form a coarse grid-like matrix across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper lateral flank, each defined by a high-luminance upper edge transitioning into a lower-luminance shadow immediately below the ridge line.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, circular high-luminance spots.
